findings.why: The measured Rp0.2 of 245 MPa is below the 250 MPa minimum of SC-01. Drawing Rev C and control plan CP-BR220-R3 are the documents in force. The 240 MPa limit comes from Rev B, which was withdrawn on 2026-06-01. The 2026-11-05 email repeats the old 6061-T6 and 240 MPa values, so it is outdated and not a controlled document. The control plan reaction for this failure is to quarantine the heat and notify the Supplier Quality Engineer, so the lot cannot be accepted as passing.
